PIONEER.Definition: a person who is among the first to develop a new area of knowledge

UNCONSCIOUS.Definition: hidden from our awareness; the part of the mind we are not aware of

PSEUDOSCIENTIST.Definition: a person who claims his ideas are based on proper research when they are not

CONSCIOUSNESS.Definition: the state of being aware of your own thoughts and surroundings

QUESTIONABLE.Definition: doubtful; not clearly good or right

HERITAGE.Definition: the family background and culture he was born into

TABOO.Definition: not allowed by society because it is seen as improper

THERAPY.Definition: treatment for mental health problems, often through talking

ASYLUMS.Definition: old-fashioned hospitals where people with mental illness were kept

TO MAKE A NAME FOR HIMSELF.Definition: to become well known and respected

ANAESTHETIC.Definition: a drug that stops you feeling pain in part of the body

HASTY.Definition: done too quickly, without enough thought

OVERDOSE.Definition: a dangerously large amount of a drug taken at once

STANDING.Definition: level of respect from other people

HYPNOSIS.Definition: a sleep-like state in which a person is very open to suggestions; the method of putting someone into it

PRACTICE.Definition: the business of a doctor or therapist, or the methods he uses in his work

COIN THE TERM.Definition: invent a new word or phrase

RIFT.Definition: a serious break in a relationship

COINED THE TERM.Definition: invented the new word or phrase

PREMISE.Definition: the basic idea that a theory or method is built on

REPRESSED.Definition: pushed out of a person's awareness

CONTEMPORARY.Definition: of that time; held by people living then

INTERPRETATION.Definition: the explanation of what something means

PROFOUND.Definition: showing deep understanding; very great and far-reaching

COMPLEX.Definition: made of many connected parts; difficult to understand

PROVOCATIVE.Definition: shocking and likely to cause strong reactions

EPONYMOUS.Definition: whose name is used for the story

SLIP.Definition: a small mistake made without meaning to

SLIP OF THE TONGUE.Definition: a small mistake in speech, made by accident

MAINSTREAM.Definition: the ideas and opinions accepted by most people

A FRESH FACE.Definition: someone new and not yet well known

PREJUDICE.Definition: an unfair dislike of a group of people

IN ITS OWN RIGHT.Definition: because of its own qualities, not because of anything else

CYNICISM.Definition: a negative, distrustful view of life

LIFELONG.Definition: lasting for as long as he lived

UNDERESTIMATED.Definition: judged to be less serious than it really was

RAIDED.Definition: entered suddenly and by force to search

WAKE UP CALL.Definition: a shock that makes someone realise a serious problem

CONCENTRATION CAMPS.Definition: prison camps where large numbers of people were held in terrible conditions

COMA.Definition: a long state of deep unconsciousness

IN HER OWN RIGHT.Definition: through her own achievements, not through someone else

REPURPOSED.Definition: used again in a different way

FRAUD.Definition: a person who tricks people by pretending to be something they are not

PSEUDOSCIENCE.Definition: ideas falsely presented as based on proper research and facts

SUBCONSCIOUS.Definition: the part of the mind that affects us without our knowing

CONMAN.Definition: a person who tricks people to get their money

CLUES.Definition: pieces of information that help solve a mystery
